requireProperty.message: deploy.releaseUrl is not set. Pass -Ddeploy.releaseUrl=<url> (CI supplies it from the MAVEN_RELEASE_URL Gitea variable).
requireProperty.regexMessage: deploy.releaseUrl is empty or malformed. It must be an absolute URL including scheme, e.g. https://host/repository/maven-releases/ — CI supplies it from the MAVEN_RELEASE_URL Gitea variable; pass -Ddeploy.releaseUrl=<url> for a manual deploy.

requireProperty.message: deploy.snapshotUrl is not set. Pass -Ddeploy.snapshotUrl=<url> (CI supplies it from the MAVEN_SNAPSHOT_URL Gitea variable). It must NOT be left empty or pointed at the release repository: an empty value makes Maven deploy snapshots INTO the release repo.
requireProperty.regexMessage: deploy.snapshotUrl is empty or malformed. It must be an absolute URL including scheme, e.g. https://host/repository/maven-snapshots/ — CI supplies it from the MAVEN_SNAPSHOT_URL Gitea variable. Do NOT point it at the release repository to silence this: an empty or release-pointing value makes Maven deploy snapshots into the release repo.

project.name: Cumba OSS coreJ Rule Editor REST
project.description: The rule editor's REST service: forge login, per-user git workspaces over JGit, branch / file / commit / push operations under the editor's server-side rules, the explorer and the free-text search over the rule corpus, and the engine's authoring API behind the analysis, the scenario grid and the runs. The published twin of cumba-corej-rule-editor-rest.
